title: Installment Settled by a One-Time TRICARE Prime Payment
content:
**Clause.** For a one-time payment on a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment: where the enrollment's payment arrangement is monthly, the one-time payment settles the monthly installment whose coverage period begins latest; where the arrangement is quarterly, it settles the quarterly installment whose coverage period begins latest; otherwise it settles the annual installment whose coverage period begins latest.

| Enrollment's payment arrangement | Installment settled |
|---|---|
| monthly | the monthly installment whose coverage period begins latest |
| quarterly | the quarterly installment whose coverage period begins latest |
| otherwise (annual) | the annual installment whose coverage period begins latest |

**Hypothetical case.** A monthly arrangement whose account holds monthly installment charges beginning 1 July and 1 August and a quarterly charge from an earlier arrangement beginning 1 April: the installment settled is the monthly one beginning 1 August.
